name: HARENDER KUMAR KHATRI
tagline: Corporate Strategy • M&A & Corporate Development • Manufacturing & Operations Excellence
summary: Corporate strategy and transformation executive with 18+ years across telecom, digital platforms, automotive manufacturing, and management consulting. Track record of shaping board-level strategy, leading end-to-end M&A, and driving multi-million-dollar impact through pricing, operations, and AI-enabled decision-making at Celcom Axiata, SEEK Asia, Maxis, and Arthur D. Little. Currently leads manufacturing excellence and operations strategy for ASK Automotive, and is a Certified Independent Director building board governance expertise.

experience.title: Chief General Manager (SVP) – Strategy, Automation & Manufacturing Excellence
bullets: Lead group-wide manufacturing excellence and operations strategy across plants, driving automation, standardization, and process re-engineering to lift cost, quality, and delivery performance.
Own the productivity improvement roadmap that is making plants more efficient, reliable, and cost-competitive at scale.

experience.title: Head of Pricing (Regional Head, Strategic Pricing & Commercial Operations)
bullets: Led commercial and pricing strategy across 6 Southeast Asian markets, overseeing a ~AUD 250M revenue portfolio.
Designed and launched an AI-driven variable pricing platform across 400+ job clusters, delivering AUD/RM 20M incremental revenue and an 8% YoY yield uplift.
Built pricing governance frameworks, risk flags, and real-time Tableau dashboards, giving leadership clear visibility into yield and adoption across markets.
Led a team of 9 analysts and managers; partnered with regional leadership to align pricing, GTM, and sales strategy with commercial objectives.

experience.title: Head of Strategy & Corporate Development
bullets: Led Celcom's Strategy & Corporate Development function reporting to the CEO and Board; directed long-term growth planning, portfolio reviews, and enterprise-wide transformation.
Executed 2 end-to-end M&A transactions (Bridgenet – cybersecurity; Infront Consulting – cloud), from due diligence through post-merger integration, unlocking RM14M in recurring B2B revenue.
Shaped Malaysia's 5G rollout, fiber, and enterprise B2B strategy; structured co-investment and partnership models that unlocked RM100M in savings and new revenue.
Launched Celcom's Data-as-a-Service platform and digital wallet ecosystem, onboarding 1M+ users and 50,000 merchants.

experience.title: Senior Strategy Specialist
bullets: Delivered RM26M in annualized cost savings by renegotiating international roaming and wholesale voice contracts and introducing carrier aggregation.
Led financial valuation, synergy assessment, and due diligence for strategic M&A targets, including Touch 'n Go, U Mobile, and Astro.
Launched Maxis's SME e-commerce platform, driving up to 18% revenue uplift for participating SME clients.

experience.title: Management Consultant
bullets: Advised Brunei's government on national competitiveness; reforms helped raise the World Bank Ease of Doing Business ranking from #101 to #84 and lifted SME share of GDP from 22% to 25% in two years.

experience.title: Management Consultant
bullets: Delivered 25+ strategy and transformation projects across banking, oil & gas, logistics, ports, and consumer sectors in Southeast Asia and India.
Led valuation and synergy modeling for DRB-Hicom's 32.3% acquisition of POS Malaysia; designed Johor Port's 25-year CAPEX roadmap.
Developed the Pengerang Petroleum Complex masterplan, attracting multi-billion-dollar FDI including Petronas RAPID, and restructured Petronas's R&D strategy.
Designed Yes Bank's SME digital lending platform, cutting loan turnaround from 7–10 days to under 48 hours.
Facilitated Malaysia's Palm Oil NKEA Lab, designing initiatives projected to add RM47B to national GNI.

Associate, Lehman Brothers, Tokyo (2006 – 2007) — Managed financial operations and equity trading analytics; recognized in the Top 1% for performance.
Analyst, Deloitte Consulting (2004 – 2006) — Supported enterprise technology integration projects, optimizing ICT strategy and cross-functional efficiency.
